title.value: N-BEATS: N EURAL BASIS EXPANSION ANALYSIS FOR INTERPRETABLE TIME SERIES FORECASTING
title.justification: The title of the paper is clearly mentioned at the beginning of the provided text.
title.quote: N-BEATS: N EURAL BASIS EXPANSION ANALYSIS FOR INTERPRETABLE TIME SERIES FORECASTING

analysis.description: The paper introduces a deep learning model called N-BEATS for univariate time series point forecasting. The model aims to achieve state-of-the-art performance without relying on time-series-specific components and focuses on interpretability and applicability across diverse domains. The architecture involves a stack of fully-connected layers and residual links, which are tested on multiple datasets including M3, M4, and TOURISM. The results show significant improvements in forecasting accuracy compared to statistical benchmarks and hybrid models.

type.justification: The paper presents empirical results from testing the N-BEATS model on various datasets like M3, M4, and TOURISM, and compares its performance with other models.
type.quote: We test the proposed architecture on several well-known datasets, including M3, M4 and TOURISM competition datasets... We demonstrate state-of-the-art performance for two configurations of N-BEATS for all the datasets.

name.justification: The entire paper revolves around the introduction, development, and evaluation of the N-BEATS model for time series forecasting.

is_contributed.justification: N-BEATS is presented as a novel contribution to the field of time series forecasting by the authors.
is_contributed.quote: To the best of our knowledge, this is the first work to empirically demonstrate that pure DL using no time-series specific components outperforms well-established statistical approaches.

is_executed.justification: The model was executed in the experiments mentioned in the paper using various datasets like M3, M4, and TOURISM.

is_compared.justification: N-BEATS was numerically compared to other models, such as the M4 competition winner and statistical benchmarks.
is_compared.quote: We demonstrate state-of-the-art performance for two configurations of N-BEATS for all the datasets, improving forecast accuracy by 11% over a statistical benchmark and by 3% over last year’s winner of the M4 competition.
